comment:
* Helper for accessing features in {@link android.hardware.display.DisplayManager}
 * introduced after API level 4 in a backwards compatible fashion.

variables.name: DISPLAY_CATEGORY_PRESENTATION
variables.comment:
* Display category: Presentation displays. *

* This category can be used to identify secondary displays that are suitable for * use as presentation displays. *

* * @see android.app.Presentation for information about presenting content * on secondary displays. * @see #getDisplays(String)

methods.name: public static DisplayManagerCompat getInstance(Context context)
methods.comment: * Gets an instance of the display manager given the context.

methods.name: public abstract Display getDisplay(int displayId)
methods.comment:
* Gets information about a logical display.
     *
     * The display metrics may be adjusted to provide compatibility
     * for legacy applications.
     *
     * @param displayId The logical display id.
     * @return The display object, or null if there is no valid display with the given id.

methods.name: public abstract Display[] getDisplays()
methods.comment:
* Gets all currently valid logical displays.
     *
     * @return An array containing all displays.

methods.name: public abstract Display[] getDisplays(String category)
methods.comment:
* Gets all currently valid logical displays of the specified category. *

* When there are multiple displays in a category the returned displays are sorted * of preference. For example, if the requested category is * {@link #DISPLAY_CATEGORY_PRESENTATION} and there are multiple presentation displays * then the displays are sorted so that the first display in the returned array * is the most preferred presentation display. The application may simply * use the first display or allow the user to choose. *

* * @param category The requested display category or null to return all displays. * @return An array containing all displays sorted by order of preference. * * @see #DISPLAY_CATEGORY_PRESENTATION
